source: due2-native: the anonymous target of the DALICC licenses (docs/design/references.md, DALICC)
notes: The target is a blank-node odrl:AssetCollection with no odrl:uid and no refinement, described only by dct:type. ODRL allows it (an Asset SHOULD have a uid, IM 2.2). Stage 1 gives it a generated identity (normalisation §5.1, case 3) that no request can name and no odrl:partOf edge reaches, so the permission is never T. W1 accepts the policy and warns AnonymousEntity (normalisation §3, issue #79). dct:type is not read as a refinement: a collection refinement is rejected (UnsupportedConstruct, #21). An author who means 'any software' names the collection and supplies its members as partOf edges.

expected.why: ex:my-app is not the generated identity of the anonymous target, and no closure edge makes it part of it, so the relation part is F (workflows §5.2). No rule applies.
The request names no target, so the relation part is U (workflows §5.2, absent is not false); the action matches. Completing the permission T gives Permit, F gives NotApplicable. Indeterminate.
